title: StructSaver
description: Save, manage and place Minecraft structures with ghost previews, rotation, mirroring and NBT support.
body:
# StructSaver

StructSaver is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.5 that allows you to save, manage and place structures directly in-game.

Whether you're building cities, redstone contraptions or decorative builds, StructSaver provides an easy way to create reusable structure templates with visual placement previews.

## Features

### Selection

- Select areas using a wooden hoe
- Two-click corner selection
- Optional single-block selection mode
- Colored selection outlines (8 presets)
- Multiplayer synchronization
- Ghost-block preview of selected structures

### Structure Library

- Save structures with custom names
- JSON-based storage format
- Searchable structure library
- Creation date display
- Rename structures
- Delete structures with confirmation dialog
- Overwrite warning for existing structures

### Placement

- Real-time ghost preview
- Green preview = valid placement
- Red preview = blocked placement
- Placement centered on the targeted block
- Rotation support
- Mirroring support
- Easy right-click placement

### NBT Support

- Export structures as Minecraft `.nbt` files
- Import existing `.nbt` structures
- Share structures between worlds and computers

### Settings

- Open settings with F6
- Toggle area and single-block selection
- Change selection outline colors
- Mod Menu integration

## Multiplayer Support

StructSaver is designed to work in multiplayer.

- Server-side structure storage
- Client-side rendering
- Network synchronization for save, load, rename, delete, preview and placement

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.5
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 25

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|------|---------|
| R | Rotate clockwise |
| T | Rotate counter-clockwise |
| F | Mirror X-axis |
| G | Mirror Z-axis |
| F6 | Open settings |

## Notes

- Placement is restricted to Creative and Spectator mode.
- Supports Minecraft's standard NBT structure format.
